args.notes: Tight accuracy spec: max_abs_err <= 2^-20 (~9.54e-07) AND throughput >= 50 MSPS simultaneously. Search the whole data-width range aggressively (high width needed to meet 2^-20; check where err saturates) and prefer families/structures that reach 50 MSPS without massive unroll cost: pipelined with modest stages and unrolled_k may both qualify. Keep the front well spread on luts_plus_ffs vs power_index; do not let the front collapse to only ultra-wide designs. Selection rule is min luts_plus_ffs, so keep many feasible low-area points, but cover the power end too.

args.lesson: high_precision (2^-20 max err @ >=50 MSPS, min luts+ffs then power): the whole 400-eval L1 budget is needed on the structured DSE graph; 400 evals returned only ONE non-dominated feasible design. Tight accuracy plus a hard throughput floor squeezes the corpus hard — data_width must go to 26 (err 6.89e-07, 2^-20.47), and feasible throughput comes from pipelined_m with modest m=7 (52 MSPS) rather than deep unrolls. Do not expect a spread front on this class; do not split budget across explore_family boxes, as partial budgets will likely miss the narrow feasible slice. L3/L4 may have no recorded rows and L5 no measured data for such designs => no winner change, no reexplore; finalize on L1/L2 estimates and state the unverified caveat.
